judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer mentions prospector and emcee-related fitting tools but never flags that emcee is described as a 'nested sampling code' rather than an MCMC sampler. There is no challenge to the method-category claim or the Foreman-Mackey et al. 2013 citation.

The review discusses SED fitting and AGN templates but does not flag the specific claim that emcee is a nested-sampling code or challenge the Foreman-Mackey et al. 2013 citation/method classification.
The reviewer mentions the use of 'prospector' for SED fitting but does not mention the code 'emcee' or challenge its methodological categorization as a nested sampling tool.
The reviewer's summary correctly states z=3.71 for Jekyll & Hyde and nowhere flags the abstract's z=3.17 as inconsistent with the body. The abstract value discrepancy is not mentioned.
Although the reviewer repeatedly states the correct redshift z = 3.71 in their own summary, they do not explicitly flag an inconsistency in the abstract or mention the incorrect z = 3.17 value.
The reviewer correctly identifies the redshift as z=3.71 in their summary and discussion, but they do not flag the inconsistent value of z=3.17 appearing in the abstract.

The reviewer discusses the overdensity concept qualitatively (Major Comment 7) but never challenges the sign in the numerator of Eq. 1 (δ = (n+n̄)/n̄ vs. the canonical δ = (n−n̄)/n̄). No mathematical error in the equation is flagged.
The reviewer comments on the overdensity values and interpretation but does not identify any error in Eq. 1 or the definition δ = (n-\bar{n})/\bar{n}, so the sign-flip is not specifically detected.
The reviewer discusses the physical interpretation of the overdensity values but does not comment on the sign error in the numerator of Equation 1.

The reviewer does not flag any figure cross-reference mismatch. There is no mention of a figure pointing to the wrong field (SXDS vs. COSMOS) or any inconsistency between figure labels and their described content.
The review mentions Fig. 1 and discusses the Jekyll & Hyde overdensity, but it does not flag a mismatched figure cross-reference between the COSMOS-field sentence and the SXDS figure label.

The reviewer provides detailed feedback on the content of the figures (specifically referring to Fig. 1) but does not identify that the text incorrectly cross-references the SXDS figure instead of the COSMOS figure.
